text.tspan: Outer setup differs by subcommand. The per-XR body is identical.
Composition-level diff, once per composition, up to three local comparisons

For each affected XR, CDP calls DP.DiffSingleResource with a provider that returns the proposed composition, and the predicted revision name for a composite that would re-point. See per-XR body below.
PerformDiff iterates the input resources, calling DiffSingleResource on each. See per-XR body below.
per-XR body. DiffSingleResource(ctx, xr, compositionProvider). Driven once per input XR (xr) or once per affected XR (comp).

Effective = input + cluster's compositionRef / compositionRevisionRef / policy / UID, or a claim's backing XR with the claim synced in. renderXR = strict Defaulter.Default(Effective). authoredXR stays as written: it is the payload.
If a revision was resolved, set renderXR's compositionRevisionRef to it (creating the ref if absent), as the reconciler does before composing.

Before starting a function for the first time - take this run's lease, reclaim dead runs' containers and networks, then the engine creates a network labelled with this run's session and each container is labelled with it too
Merge the nested diffs and rendered resources into this XR's, so removal detection sees what nested XRs still compose
Walk the tree. A composed resource is removed when its composite no longer desires its composition resource name
[Top-level XR that exists in the cluster]
Cleanup runs before output is rendered, so a teardown advisory reaches warnings[]
The run removes its labelled containers, the engine removes its network, the run removes any of its networks left, then releases its lease

did the composition change at all (masks lifted)?
is last-applied-configuration the sole delta (revision name unpredictable)?
FetchCurrentObject (the XR unless a nested XR copy is supplied, plus a claim backing XR)
cluster copy / backing XR (fetch error is fatal)
ResolvedComposition (cluster's composition and revision, or proposed under comp)
observed composed resources (fetch failure is fatal)
RenderToStableState(ctx, renderXR, comp, fns, id, observed, eventualState)
lenient Defaulter.Default(desired), mark dryRun.skipReason=disabled (+ storageVersion if the CRD stores another version)
diffs + rendered (keys, desired resource names per composite)
Recurse via diffSingleResourceInternal with the nested XR's cluster copy, without removal detection (err if depth > --max-nested-depth)
